name: CENGILD
recent: Cengild 在 2026 年 9 月启动了一项战略股权参与计划，通过私募方式向医疗顾问配售最多 2% 的股份，并于 11 月 10 日以每股 RM0.1437 配售了 900 万股。公司于 11 月 23 日公布了截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度的业绩，净利同比下滑 9.66%。此外，公司将于 11 月 27 日召开第六届常年股东大会。
notable: 公司通过战略股权参与计划，以每股 RM0.1437 配售 900 万股新股，于 2026 年 11 月 11 日上市。
公司将于 2026 年 11 月 27 日召开第六届常年股东大会。
公司公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度业绩，净利同比下滑 9.66% 至 RM2.64 million。
risks: 战略股权参与计划涉及发行最多 2% 的新股，可能对现有股东造成股权摊薄。
公司净利同比下滑 9.66%，尽管营收有所增长。

news.title: Cengild Medical 1Q FY2027 Net Profit Falls 9.66% to RM2.64 Million Despite Revenue Growth
Trading ideas: Genting, CBH, Vestland, PA resources, Zetrix, TT Vision, MN, Pekat, Gas Malaysia, Hengyuan Refining, Hextar Retail, KSL, NexG Bina, Cengild, Butterfield
Cengild plans placement of up to 2% of shares to medical consultants

recent_en: Cengild launched a Strategic Equity Participation Plan in September 2026, involving a private placement of up to 2% of its shares to medical consultants, and placed 9 million shares at RM0.1437 each on 10 November. The company announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 23 November, with net profit falling 9.66% year-on-year.
notable_en: The company placed 9 million new shares at RM0.1437 each under its Strategic Equity Participation Plan, listed on 11 November 2026.
The company announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026, with net profit down 9.66% year-on-year to RM2.64 million.
risks_en: The Strategic Equity Participation Plan involves the issuance of up to 2% new shares, which may dilute existing shareholders.
Net profit fell 9.66% year-on-year despite revenue growth.
